title: unix_secs_to_rfc3339 doc claims correctness only from 1970-03-01
description: kith_core::unix_secs_to_rfc3339 documents 'Correct for dates from 1970-03-01 through 2299' but the existing test oracle at t=0 returns 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z correctly, and t=86400 returns 1970-01-02T00:00:00Z correctly. The Hinnant algorithm handles the full range including the first 59 days of 1970; the lower-bound claim in the docstring is misleading and may cause a caller to add unnecessary validation.
